name: ai-sec-monorepo
description: LLM Security Gateway + Red-Team CI MVP

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ai-sec/security-core && npm run build --workspace @ai-sec/redteam-runner && npm run build --workspace @codegrammer/ai-sec-openclaw-adapter && npm run build --workspace @ai-sec/gateway && npm run build --workspace @codegrammer/ai-sec-cli
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @ai-sec/security-core && npm run build --workspace @ai-sec/redteam-runner && npm run dev --workspace @ai-sec/gateway
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @ai-sec/security-core && npm run lint --workspace @ai-sec/redteam-runner && npm run lint --workspace @codegrammer/ai-sec-openclaw-adapter && npm run lint --workspace @ai-sec/gateway && npm run lint --workspace @codegrammer/ai-sec-cli
scripts.release:verify: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test --workspace @ai-sec/gateway && npm run test --workspace @codegrammer/ai-sec-cli && npm run test --workspace @codegrammer/ai-sec-openclaw-adapter && npm run redteam -- --suite prompt_injection_core --target-model release-check-model
scripts.release: npm run release:verify && npm run release:cli:pack && npm run release:adapter:pack && npm run release:cli:checksums
